<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="T_Txx3Xaxb4ICrfqFrLV"> <mxGraphModel dx="857" dy="-603" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #FFF3EE
 BorderColor #E8611A
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 11
}
skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor #FFE0D0
 BorderColor #E8611A
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 12
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #FFFAF8
 BorderColor #F0A882
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam arrow {
 Color #E8611A
 FontColor #E8611A
 FontSize 10
}

left to right direction

actor \"Student\" as Student #LightSalmon

rectangle \"AI-Driven Smart LMS — Student Portal\" {

 package \"Authentication\" {
 usecase \"Login (Email /\nFace Recognition)\" as UC_Login
 usecase \"Update Profile\" as UC_Profile
 }

 package \"Course & Enrollment\" {
 usecase \"View Enrolled\nCourses\" as UC_Courses
 usecase \"View Course\nDetails & CLOs\" as UC_Details
 }

 package \"Attendance\" {
 usecase \"View Attendance\nper Course\" as UC_Att
 usecase \"Receive Shortage\nAlert\" as UC_Alert
 }

 package \"Assessment\" {
 usecase \"Submit\nAssignment\" as UC_Submit
 usecase \"Attempt\nQuiz\" as UC_Quiz
 usecase \"View Exam\nResults & Grades\" as UC_Results
 }

 package \"AI-Powered Features\" {
 usecase \"Use AI Chatbot\n(Gemini + RAG)\" as UC_Chatbot
 usecase \"Generate AI\nPractice Quiz\" as UC_AIQuiz
 usecase \"View Performance\nAnalytics\" as UC_Analytics
 usecase \"View Class\nLeaderboard\" as UC_Leader
 }

 package \"Fee Management\" {
 usecase \"View Fee\nVouchers\" as UC_Fee
 usecase \"Check Payment\nStatus\" as UC_PayStatus
 }

 package \"Communication\" {
 usecase \"View Announcements\n& Notices\" as UC_Ann
 usecase \"Participate in\nCourse Chat\" as UC_Chat
 }
}

' ── Associations ─────────────────────────────────
Student --> UC_Login
Student --> UC_Profile

Student --> UC_Courses
Student --> UC_Details

Student --> UC_Att
Student --> UC_Alert

Student --> UC_Submit
Student --> UC_Quiz
Student --> UC_Results

Student --> UC_Chatbot
Student --> UC_AIQuiz
Student --> UC_Analytics
Student --> UC_Leader

Student --> UC_Fee
Student --> UC_PayStatus

Student --> UC_Ann
Student --> UC_Chat

' ── Include / Extend ─────────────────────────────
UC_Login .> UC_Courses : <<include>>
UC_Att .> UC_Alert : <<extend>>
UC_AIQuiz .> UC_Quiz : <<extend>>
UC_Leader .> UC_Analytics : <<include>>
UC_PayStatus .> UC_Fee : <<include>>
